mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.project_id, i.issue_no, i.issue_title, i.auditor_id, u.real_name AS auditor_name, i.status, i.evidence_count FROM audit_issue i LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.auditor_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE i.project_id = #{projectId} AND i.deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.issue_no
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_issue SET evidence_count = GREATEST(evidence_count + #{delta}, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
